transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Hi Marco. You missed last Tuesday's appointment. What happened?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Double shift at the warehouse. I'm sorry, I should have called.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Thanks. How is the left ankle today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Pain is down to 2 out of 10 in the morning, and 3 by evening.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I can walk the dog around the block now without a limp.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Dorsiflexion is 15 degrees on the left, and 18 on the right.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Single-leg balance: you held for 12 seconds on the left, which is short.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I wobble when I look at my phone.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Any sharp pain on the outside of the ankle when you go down stairs?

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Your home program was calf stretches and balance on one foot. How many days this week?

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Plan: add a balance board, and two clinic sessions a week for the next three weeks. I'm not clearing you to run yet.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: We'll talk about running when balance is steady and the swelling is gone.

expectedFacts.statement: Missed last appointment after a double shift
Pain 2 out of 10 in the morning
Walks the dog without a limp
Single-leg balance held 12 seconds on the left
Home program done three or four days
Two clinic sessions a week for three weeks
